Uttar Pradesh by-elections set to intensify political battle over Datiya seat

The upcoming by-election in the Datiya constituency of Uttar Pradesh is expected to be a significant test for both the ruling BJP and the opposition Congress. The by-election has been triggered due to the resignation of the incumbent MLA, and both parties are gearing up for a fierce battle. The BJP has nominated a single candidate, while the Congress party is planning to play on the issue of 'empathy' to gain an upper hand.
